scope: Graph-operation recorder visual-asset bounds and deterministic Node Detail fixture grading
assertions: Recorder limits widen only the exact graph asset, accepted-asset read, and bounded import-validation routes; ordinary graph operations retain the 4 MiB cap and oversized responses are rejected while streaming.
Recorder receipts remain bounded and omit transported asset bytes and bearer credentials.
EvalService invokes the registered gradeExecution hook and the integration assertion observes all three fixture-specific checks.

The grader rejects absent or integrity-invalid authored detail, unsupported media, missing image or capability evidence, missing accepted actions, and integrity-consistent mount/HTML host mismatches using parsed fragments.
The grader intentionally does not claim accepted-byte delivery or pixel rendering; those remain covered by separate Product evidence.
